method: WebFetch (remote, text). Quotes from HTML pages pass through the WebFetch extraction step; PDF quotes were extracted locally with pymupdf from the official PDF. Spot-check word for word before shipping (rule 7).

steps.step: NVQ framework: seven levels; Levels 5-6 National Diploma; Level 7 Bachelors Degree, certified by UoVT (Univotec)
steps.quote: Level 7 recognizes the vocational/technological competencies at Bachelors Degree level ... Certification of 1 – 6 levels shall be carried out by institutions accredited by the TVEC. Certification at level 7 shall be carried out by the Univotec.
steps.locator: NVQ Framework of Sri Lanka Operations Manual, October 2009, PDF p.13 (level table)
steps.caveat: Document dated October 2009. A 2021 manual indexed at tvec.gov.lk/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/NVQ_Operation_Manual_2021_new.pdf returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-15.

steps.requirement: Relevant NVQ Level 5 or Level 6 qualification; NVQ 6 holders eligible for credit transfer determined by UoVT
steps.quote: NVQ level 7 programmes conducted by the Univotec allow students to acquire B.Tech. or B.Ed. Tech. degree qualifications. Pathways, from the National Diplomas, will be available to students who have achieved the relevant NVQ qualifications at levels 5 or level 6 to proceed to degree programmes. Those with NVQ level 6 qualifications are eligible to receive appropriate credit transfer towards the degree programme, to be determined by the Univotec.
steps.locator: Operations Manual Oct 2009, PDF p.17, Section 2.3 (c) NVQ Level 7

steps.step: NVQ Level 5 -> NVQ Level 6 (same technology area)
steps.requirement: NVQ Level 5 qualification in the same technology area
steps.quote: A level 5 qualification allows direct entry to the NVQ level 6 training programme in the same technology area with the credits earned towards the NVQ level 5 qualification counted towards the NVQ level 6 qualification.
steps.locator: Operations Manual Oct 2009, PDF p.17, Section 2.3 (b)

steps.step: Framework rule for entering an NVQ Level 5 diploma (2009 text)
steps.requirement: NVQ Level 3 or 4 in a relevant occupation (lateral entry via TVEC mapping / RPL)
steps.quote: The entry qualification to the Level 5 Diploma program is therefore fixed at NVQ Level 3 or Level 4 in a relevant occupation. The list of relevant occupations for each level 5 diploma will be notified when applications are called for these programmes. There is also a path of lateral entry for students with non NVQ qualifications mapped by the TVEC
steps.locator: Operations Manual Oct 2009, PDF p.16, Section 2.3 (b)
steps.caveat: Does not mention A/L. Current DTET (Gazette 31.10.2025) and VTA course entries accept 3 A/L passes as an alternative; see routes R032-R039.

steps.step: NVQ Level 5 or 6 diploma after A/L
steps.requirement: After G.C.E. A/L: direct entry to NVQ Level 5 or 6
steps.quote: Direct entry to Level 5 or 6 (Diploma/HND). Specialized for technical streams.
steps.locator: NVQ Pathway page, entry point "After G.C.E. A/L" (the same card lists "Level 7 Degree Path")

steps.step: UoVT is the NVQ 7 degree-awarding body
steps.quote: Degree Awarding Body (NVQ 7) ... The apex body of the NVQSL Framework. ... UoVT is the only government university in Sri Lanka dedicated to offering degree-level pathways for diploma holders.
steps.locator: NVQ Pathway page; level table there: 5 = Diploma (Supervisor), 6 = Higher Diploma (Technologist), 7 = Bachelor's Degree (Professional)

steps.requirement: NVQ Level 5 or Level 6, or equivalent; apply via the UoVT online portal within the published period; aptitude test; interview depending on programme
steps.quote: UoVT generally accepts NVQ Level 5 or Level 6, or equivalent qualifications.
steps.locator: Admission page, Step 01. Step 02: "Submit your application through the official UoVT online portal within the published period."

steps.institution: Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka (VTA)
steps.quote: The NVQ level 7 is equivalent to the bachelor degree qualification.
steps.locator: VTA NVQ page; same page: "the NVQ is designed for the job seekers soon after their A/L exams."

selection.quote: Comprehensive Framework for Student Selection: Intake 2025/2026 ... Final CSS = (S-NAR × 0.4) + (ATR × 0.6) ... Tie-Breaker NVQ Applicants B2: For NVQ stream applicants where Z-scores are absent, the selection will be based on ATR. In case of same final marks, verifiable experience after obtaining NVQ 4/5 qualification is used as the tie-breaker.
selection.note: Intake 2025/2026 document, already cited by R042. A/L applicants ranked on stream-weighted Z-score (40%) + aptitude (60%); NVQ applicants on aptitude.
